headline: North-West's SLA drop, driven by a broken conveyor and staffing gaps, is dragging fulfilment down.
body: North-West SLA fell nearly 13 points, the biggest driver of the overall 3.8% decline [E5]. A conveyor failure and picker shortage at WH-07 caused repeated delivery delays [E1]. That's already pushing at least one enterprise customer to shift volume to a competitor [E2]. Other regions are stable, so this is a localized, fixable problem.

actions.driver: WH-07 conveyor failure and staffing shortage
actions.action: Activate 3PL overflow for North-West lanes now
actions.monitoring: Track North-West SLA % weekly until back to baseline

what_could_change: Confirmation that conveyor repair and picker hiring are complete would strengthen this conclusion.
caveats: A competitor's new express delivery service may also be pulling customer volume away.
